class TestErrorTypes:
    """Tests for error type hierarchy and structure."""

    def test_store_write_error_is_identity_resolution_error(self):
        """StoreWriteError is a subtype of IdentityResolutionError."""
        err = StoreWriteError(
            message="disk full",
            unknown_id="u1",
            confirmed_id="c1",
        )
        assert isinstance(err, IdentityResolutionError), (
            "StoreWriteError should be a subtype of IdentityResolutionError"
        )

    def test_match_suggestion_error_is_identity_resolution_error(self):
        """MatchSuggestionError is a subtype of IdentityResolutionError."""
        err = MatchSuggestionError(
            message="backend timeout",
            identifier="user@x.com",
        )
        assert isinstance(err, IdentityResolutionError), (
            "MatchSuggestionError should be a subtype of IdentityResolutionError"
        )

    def test_store_write_error_carries_context(self):
        """StoreWriteError carries unknown_id and confirmed_id."""
        err = StoreWriteError(
            message="permission denied",
            unknown_id="uid",
            confirmed_id="cid",
        )
        assert err.unknown_id == "uid"
        assert err.confirmed_id == "cid"
        assert "permission denied" in err.message

    def test_match_suggestion_error_carries_identifier(self):
        """MatchSuggestionError carries the failing identifier."""
        err = MatchSuggestionError(
            message="index corrupt",
            identifier="broken@x.com",
        )
        assert err.identifier == "broken@x.com"
        assert "index corrupt" in err.message

    def test_identity_resolution_error_has_message(self):
        """Base IdentityResolutionError carries a human-readable message."""
        err = IdentityResolutionError(message="something went wrong")
        assert err.message == "something went wrong"

    def test_identity_resolution_error_optional_context(self):
        """IdentityResolutionError.context defaults to empty dict."""
        err = IdentityResolutionError(message="test")
        context = getattr(err, "context", {})
        assert isinstance(context, dict), "context should be a dict"

class TestInvariants:

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_no_candidates_is_empty_tuple_not_none(self):
        """INVARIANT: No-candidates is always an empty tuple, never None."""
        mr = MatchResult(
            unknown=make_unknown_identifier(),

        )
        assert mr.candidates is not None
        assert mr.candidates == ()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_collect_result_count_lte_input_count(self):
        """INVARIANT: Number of results ≤ number of input unknowns (some may be pre-filtered)."""
        unknowns = frozenset({"a@x.com", "b@x.com", "c@x.com"})

        async def _has_alias(identifier: str) -> bool:
            return identifier == "b@x.com"  # one is known

        store = _make_mock_alias_store()
        store.has_alias.side_effect = _has_alias
        suggester = _make_mock_suggester(default_candidates=())
        collector = UnknownCollector(match_suggester=suggester, alias_store=store)

        result = await collector.collect_and_match(unknowns=unknowns, source="scan")

        assert len(result) <= len(unknowns), (
            f"Result count ({len(result)}) should be <= input count ({len(unknowns)})"
        )
        assert len(result) == 2, "One was pre-filtered, so expect 2"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_self_match_never_in_candidates_invariant(self):
        """INVARIANT: Self-matches are never present in MatchResult.candidates."""
        # Provide candidates where one is a self-match
        self_match = make_match_candidate(
            canonical_id="target@company.com",
            confidence=1.0,
            display_name="Self",
        )
        legit = make_match_candidate(
            canonical_id="real-canonical",
            confidence=0.7,
            display_name="Real Person",
        )
        suggester = _make_mock_suggester(default_candidates=(self_match, legit))
        store = _make_mock_alias_store(has_alias_return=False)
        collector = UnknownCollector(match_suggester=suggester, alias_store=store)

        result = await collector.collect_and_match(
            unknowns=frozenset({"target@company.com"}),
            source="scan",
        )

        assert len(result) == 1
        for candidate in result[0].candidates:
            assert candidate.canonical_id != "target@company.com", (
                "Self-match must be filtered from candidates"
            )

    def test_tuple_immutability_for_collections(self):
        """INVARIANT: tuple is used for frozen model collection fields."""
        mr = MatchResult(
            unknown=make_unknown_identifier(),
            candidates=(
                make_match_candidate(canonical_id="c1", confidence=0.9),
                make_match_candidate(canonical_id="c2", confidence=0.5),
            ),
        )
        assert isinstance(mr.candidates, tuple), (
            f"candidates should be a tuple, got {type(mr.candidates)}"
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_composition_not_inheritance(self):
        """INVARIANT: UnknownCollector uses composition for dependencies, not inheritance."""
        # Verify UnknownCollector does NOT inherit from MatchSuggester, AliasStore, etc.
        assert not issubclass(UnknownCollector, type(_make_mock_suggester())), (
            "UnknownCollector should not inherit from MatchSuggester"
        )
        # Just verify it's constructible via composition
        collector = UnknownCollector(
            match_suggester=_make_mock_suggester(),
            alias_store=_make_mock_alias_store(),
        )
        assert collector is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_confirm_match_writes_to_alias_store(self):
        """INVARIANT: After confirm_match succeeds, alias_store.has_alias returns True."""
        fake_store = FakeAliasStore()
        suggester = _make_mock_suggester()
        collector = UnknownCollector(match_suggester=suggester, alias_store=fake_store)

        # Before confirmation
        assert await fake_store.has_alias("new@test.com") is False

        await collector.confirm_match(
            unknown_id="new@test.com",
            confirmed_id="canonical-new",
            source="test",
        )

        # After confirmation
        assert await fake_store.has_alias("new@test.com") is True, (
            "AliasStore should contain the alias after confirm_match"
        )
